translation: From the beginning, the cloud essence of the Nine Tripods and the rainbow elixir of the red shallot were treasured together, and the eight jade crimson snow together with jade fluid and wind fruit were called extraordinary. The divine pill of the Kshatriya can satisfy one for a whole day, and the precious bait of Agada can save all living beings. None do not carefully seek the origin of the red whip, and secretly excel in the art of the blue bag. Yet the physician Bian Que is rarely encountered; if Xun's viscera could speak, then the complexion would be like earth. Even if the rabbit elixir is completed, if one relies only on the famous classics of the jia and yi, then the disease enters the diaphragm (肓).
